title: OneCatalog Pricing | Catalogue Maker Plans in India
description: OneCatalog pricing: ₹1,999 a year for 20 products, ₹3,999 for 50 products with your own domain. Pay ₹999 to start, refunded if you do not approve.
h1: OneCatalog pricing. One price, set by how many products you have.
answer: OneCatalog pricing starts at ₹1,999 a year for up to 20 products. Most shops choose ₹3,999 for the first year for up to 50 products, which includes your own domain, then ₹2,999 a year. The price depends only on how many products you have.
sub: You pay ₹999 to start. You pay the rest only after you see your catalogue live and approve it.

blocks.p: Not sure how many products to include? Start with your best sellers. You can move to a bigger plan later. For trade examples, read how the catalogue works for [wholesalers](/catalogue-maker/wholesale) and [jewellers](/catalogue-maker/jewellery).

blocks.p: Updates are included: 12 update requests a year, each for up to 10 products. After that, extra batches cost ₹299 for 10 products.

items.q: Why is renewal cheaper than the first year?
items.a: The first year includes building your catalogue and setting up your domain. Renewal covers hosting and updates only, so it costs less. On the 50 product plan, renewal is ₹2,999 a year.

items.q: What if I do not like my catalogue?
items.a: We fix what is wrong first. If you still do not approve it, the ₹999 is fully refunded and you owe nothing more.

items.q: What happens if I do not renew?
items.a: Your catalogue goes offline after a 15-day grace period. Your domain is registered in your business name, so you keep it either way.

No. There is no free plan. You pay ₹999 to start, and that is refunded if you do not approve the finished catalogue. If you want something free, the catalog inside the WhatsApp Business app costs nothing. Our [WhatsApp catalogue page](/whatsapp-catalogue) compares the two.

items.q: What if I have more than 300 products?
items.a: Message us with your product count and we will quote a price.

items.q: How do I pay, and do I get a GST invoice?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp and we will share the payment options and invoice details before you pay anything.

cta.heading: Ask which plan fits your shop
cta.text: Tell us what you sell and how many products you have. We reply within 2 hours, 9am to 9pm.
